target: Task-level existence of a compliant completion in the supplied scope, or exact advertised tool-interface inconsistency. Authorization tension with a safe no-op is not automatically no-completion.
reference: Independent blind native model review plus explicit mathematical checks; not human gold. Cases with unresolved reference disagreement excluded from binary scoring and retained for abstention reporting.

metrics.recall: TP/(TP+FN+abstained_reference_positive), null if no reference positives

cost: Record actual known tokens/dollars; unknown stays null, not zero. No explicit paid API calls.
latency: Batch wall clock includes orchestration/tool reads; not comparable to isolated local checker latency.
disclosure: 24 selected development cases; not representative or held-out production benchmark.
Native judge model identity/version may be unknown; cannot certify frontier strength or cross-model independence.

Natural inputs are source-linked excerpts/paraphrases with full-source verification required by native arms. Mechanical arm runs reviewed finite projections for supported cases and abstains otherwise.
Extraction is separately evaluated; this is not an end-to-end superiority test.
No judge tuning after predictions; amendments require a new run ID and report changes.
